title: Queue review: a concept-led HTML demonstration

brief.purpose: Make the location of a fictional queue understandable; propose a measured trial without claiming causation.
brief.destination: HTML concept demonstration. Native PPTX custom slides need deliberate reconstruction after approval.

creative_brief.audience_change: Locate the transfer queue before discussing more upstream capacity.
creative_brief.central_tension: Activities can be completed while work still waits between teams.
creative_brief.distinctive_material: A ten-order fictional snapshot with six received and four waiting; no measured causes or ROI.
creative_brief.creative_latitude: Spatial explanation and editorial typography; preserve counts, limitations and readability.
creative_brief.takeaway: Test the handoff hypothesis and measure the result.

alternatives.decision: Not chosen: no supplied longitudinal order record.
Not chosen: no activity-time dataset; would overstate the available snapshot.

creative_plan.rationale: Use space for the transfer boundary, exact unit counts for evidence and a labelled test for the next step.
creative_plan.rhythm: Question, counted proof, proposed test, exact lookup. The metaphor stops at the snapshot; it does not establish a cause.

voice.register: Direct, measured, no claim of a proven remedy.
